messages.author: e5d0b3c2486cd4e3
messages.subject: Adding new geom definition to a package
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to create a package that includes a new geom definition. I
can source the geom definition into .GlobalEnv and have the geom work
as expected. However, if I put the geom definition into a package, I
get the error:

Error in geom_test() : attempt to apply non-function

There is no NAMESPACE in the package and I'm not sure if adding one
would make any difference. Any suggestions?

Here's a reproducible example (sessionInfo at the end):

***ggplotTest/DESCRIPTION***
Package: ggplotTest
Title: Test bed for ggplot extensions
License: GPL
Version: 0.1
Date: 2011-10-07
Author: Sundar Dorai-Raj <sdorairaj@****.com>
Maintainer: Sundar Dorai-Raj <sdorairaj@****.com>
Depends: R (>= 2.12), ggplot2 (>= 0.8.9)
Description: None

***ggplotTest/R/geom_test.R***
TestGrob <- function(x, y, colour = "black", linetype = 1) {
gp <- gpar(col = colour, lty = linetype)
lg <- linesGrob(x = x, y = y, default.units = "native", gp = gp)
return(gList(line = lg))
}

GeomTest <- proto(Geom, {
draw <- function(., data, scales, coordinates, ...) {
with(coordinates$transform(data, scales),
TestGrob(x, y, colour, linetype))
}
draw_legend <- function(., data, ...) {
data <- aesdefaults(data, .$default_aes(), list(...))
with(data,
ggname(.$my_name(), TestGrob(x, y, colour, linetype)))
}
objname <- "test"
desc <- "ggplot test"
default_stat <- function(.) {
StatIdentity
}
required_aes <- c("x", "y")
default_aes <- function(.) {
aes(colour = "black", linetype = 1)
}
guide_geom <- function(.) {
"test"
}
})

geom_test <- GeomTest$build_accessor()

***INSTALL***
R CMD INSTALL ggplotTest
